resolved_conflict.title: DRY (Clean Code) vs Bounded Context Autonomy (Domain-Driven Design)
resolved_conflict.principle_a: Every piece of knowledge or code must have a single, unambiguous representation within a system.
resolved_conflict.principle_b: Subsystems must maintain autonomous domain models to evolve independently without hidden coupling.
resolved_conflict.resolution: SCOPE BOUNDARY RESOLUTION: Inside a single module/package, DRY is mandatory (no duplicate functions, no copy-pasted SQL). Across distinct Bounded Contexts (e.g. Ingestion Context vs Billing Context), DRY is intentionally suspended: duplicate DTOs and data models are preferred over creating a shared monolithic entity library that creates cross-team deployment coupling.
